code.title: Day Planner
code.description: A daily planner with accounts and reminders that arrive as push notifications. I wrote the React frontend and, for the first time, the API and the database as well.
points: Node.js API with Hono, PostgreSQL with Drizzle
Sign up, login and password reset by email
Push reminders with a service worker
You can use it without an account first
